summary: Read n plus 1 integers. Each integer lies between 1 and n, with both ends included. Exactly one value occurs more than once, and that value may occur three or more times, while every other value occurs at most once. The list may be read but must not be modified at any position. Find the repeated value and write it. Leave the original list contents unchanged.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
